correctness.rationale: Every primitive period-five orbit determines a cyclic length-five proper line word. Exactly six words exist modulo rotation. Affine orthogonal projection along each word has a unique candidate; for two reflected word pairs a branch gap is negative under all allowed parameter values. For the surviving reflected pair the exact five gaps have positive denominators and signs governed by P and R; Descartes sign isolation, \(B(u)-P(u)=(u^2-1)(9u^2+7)\), and A monotonicity prove positivity exactly between the unique positive roots. At endpoints equality is a tie and fixes the point. The return multiplier \(-(u-1)^3/(u+1)^4\) has modulus below one in the window. All symbolic reductions were independently replayed by checker.py, which reconstructs 30 choice gaps, and 12 rational-height censuses are supplementary only.

value.rationale: Primitive five-cycle existence, location and stability are motivated invariants for Everett’s isosceles farthest-projection bifurcation family. The complete six-itinerary elimination produces one bounded parameter chamber, a pair of symmetry-related attracting cycles and distinct algebraic tie-collision endpoints, neither implied by lower-period data. This is a substantive exact phase diagram for a natural next prime period, not an arbitrary parameter sample or a recomputed table. Higher periods and global basin geometry remain outside scope.
